title: Playstation 5 Controller Stand/Playstation Crystal
author: user_2530493134
description:
**Playstation Crystal - Playstation 5 Controller Stand!**

This is another nice looking PS5 Controller stand in the shape of a great crystal node!

I really like how the design turned out and hope you guys do too!

**\*\*NEW - Design!** \- The Charger Charm Crystal! Complete the Crystal look with **THIS** print, Totally new Idea that makes it look like a Crystal Growing out the top of your PS5 controller while you charge it!

**XBox** version **here** !

**PS4** version **here**!

**Switch Pro** version here!

The stand has a **Perfect snug fit!**

Due to the 3d-Scanning of the real controller and careful 3d modeling around it.

**NOTE!**

Remember to choose the correct profiles when downloading, hence I can only guarantee the result on the ones I've made.

Look for the label “Designer” on the profiles.

The **silk magenta** displays the higher quality printprofile at 0.12mm layer hight!

The **Teal** one shows the standard 0.2mm layer hight model.

I do look forward to your suggestions in further improvements of the design, and I'd like to see your prints in different colors or materials. Maybe print it in a gradient filament?

Happy Printing!
